candidate_relations.reason: A metastatic tumor is a secondary malignancy, whereas the reference diagnosis is a benign vascular hemangioma.
Cardiac metastasis denotes secondary malignant involvement and is not equivalent to a cardiac hemangioma.
A left ventricular fibroma is a fibrous tumor, not the vascular hemangioma specified by the reference.
Rhabdomyoma is a striated-muscle tumor and is distinct from hemangioma.
Papillary fibroelastoma is an endocardial papillary tumor, not a vascular hemangioma.
A left ventricular lipoma is an adipose tumor and is distinct from hemangioma.
A left ventricular fibroelastoma is not equivalent to the referenced vascular hemangioma.
